workPosts.title: SQM (BW8)
workPosts.description:
December 2025 public gallery, Baghdad walk

A land carpeted by DEATH.

"SQM" is an abbreviation for a square meter which is the measuring unit for the area, especially the area of the land that is filled with landmine all across the border strip with Iran and Kuwait.

That was a brief introduction for my 'textile art' artwork with Tarkib, Haifa street, Baghdad.
@tarkib_baghdad

The area of Iraqi land that's considered to be contaminated with landmines and unexploded war remnants are estimated as nearly 6 million square meters.
Endangering the country's ability to develop by preventing using these contaminated lands for either industries or agriculture.
Not only that but also surely endangering human and wild life especially kids as estimated to be 70 casualties each year by landmines most of them are poor kids.

And lastly due to soil erosions these landmines and war remnants are crawling as a silent killer towards our villages and archaeological sites putting our lives and history at risk, such as the ziggurat of Ur in Dhi Qar province, in addition to Maysan, Wasit and the borders of Basra.

It is a women's dress as a show of appreciation and thankfulness for the role of the Iraqi women teams that are putting themselves at risk to clear our lands from landmines and war remnants out of the very few teams that are trying to do so.

Each element of the dress represents a certain meaning related to the subject of the artwork.

Three types of fabrics are used (Satin dark brown represents the landmines colour, Chiffon deserty golden beige represents the colour of land, black Velvet represents the burnt land by landmines which is wrapped around the neck in a metaphor to suffocation).

Barbed wires the same ones that are used in the 80s by Iraq and Iran to prevent the civilians from crossing into landmines wrapped around the body.

The whole dress would be visualised as a map of iraq (not the shape of it but the distribution) most affected lands with landmines are marked with red beads.
